name: Max Wallet
summary: A routed buy may not take a wallet's balance of the coin above a cap.
behavior: Before a routed buy: denied if the wallet's balance plus the estimated tokens exceeds the cap.
After a routed buy: the trade reverts if the observed balance exceeds the cap.
Optional window: from market activation or a fixed time, for a set duration (or always).
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Applies to trades routed through Pump Hooks only. A transaction that trades on Pump directly is not affected.
The cap is per wallet token account: one person using several wallets, or receiving tokens by transfer, is not limited.
